home.title: Full Plate Intelligence | Restaurant Financial Insights for Independent Restaurants
home.description: Full Plate Intelligence (Full Plate Intel) helps independent restaurant owners see their numbers the way top operators do: a free weekly newsletter on food cost, labor, cash flow and profitability, with restaurant research and benchmarking tools on the way.

weekly.title: Full Plate Weekly | Free Restaurant Financial Newsletter
weekly.description: Full Plate Weekly is a free restaurant newsletter with practical financial insights for independent owners: food cost, labor cost, cash flow, occupancy and profitability, in one short email a week.

show.title: The Full Plate Show | Restaurant Business Conversations
show.description: The Full Plate Show is an upcoming restaurant podcast: practical conversations with owners, chefs, investors, lenders and technologists about the decisions that shape a restaurant business.

index.title: Restaurant Intelligence Index | Independent Restaurant Industry Report
index.description: The Restaurant Intelligence Index is a planned twice-yearly restaurant industry report built from independent restaurant data: sales and profitability, food and beverage costs, labor and productivity, operator sentiment and technology. Paid per edition.

benchmark.title: Full Plate Benchmark | Restaurant Financial Benchmarking
benchmark.description: Full Plate Benchmark is a planned restaurant benchmarking tool: compare food cost, labor, prime cost and profitability against restaurants like yours by concept, cuisine, revenue and market. Paid Quick Calculator and Full Benchmark Report.

steve.title: Steve Dillberg | Founder of Full Plate Intelligence
steve.description: Meet Steve Dillberg, restaurant accountant and advisor, founder of Full Plate Intelligence and founding partner of Schofer Dillberg & Company, with more than 25 years advising restaurant owners and operators.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Full Plate Intelligence
privacy.description: How Full Plate Intelligence collects and uses your email address and what happens when you join the Full Plate Weekly list.

terms.title: Terms of Use | Full Plate Intelligence
terms.description: Terms of use for the Full Plate Intelligence website and Full Plate Weekly newsletter.

contact.title: Contact | Full Plate Intelligence
contact.description: Questions, feedback or ideas for Full Plate Intelligence? Email Steve directly.

copy_changes.original: Join restaurant owners and operators.
copy_changes.replacement: For independent restaurant owners.
copy_changes.reason: Prelaunch: nobody has joined yet, so the note now states who the newsletter is for instead of implying an existing audience.

copy_changes.original: Free forever. One email a week. No fluff.
copy_changes.replacement: Free. Confirm your email and you are on the list; Full Plate Weekly starts sending when the first issue is ready. One short email a week, no fluff.

copy_changes.original: Turn numbers into better decisions.
copy_changes.replacement:
Turn numbers into better decisions.

Illustrative example, not an industry benchmark. Actual costs and profit vary. Percentages are shares of sales using simplified categories.

copy_changes.replacement: Compare your numbers with similar restaurants by revenue, concept, and location. See where you stand and where to improve. Paid tools, in development.

copy_changes.original:
Anonymized

Identifiers are removed. No individual restaurant is ever named or recognizable.
copy_changes.replacement:
Anonymized

Identifiers are removed before analysis. No individual restaurant is named, and results are reported only in aggregate.

copy_changes.original: The Index reports patterns across many restaurants, never the position of any one of them. Contributed data is used only to build the Index.

copy_changes.reason: The "used only to build the Index" promise conflicts with possible cross-product use (Benchmark); consent scope must be decided, not silently broadened.
copy_changes.approval: Steve/legal: decide the permitted uses of contributed data and whether SDC client information may ever be included.
